prompt:
An option with show_envvar=True renders some envvar values badly. With option = click.Option(["--units"], envvar=..., show_envvar=True, required=True) and no value given, the error hint is:

| envvar | now | expected |
| --- | --- | --- |
| None | Error: Missing option '--units'. | (unchanged) |
| "" | Error: Missing option '--units' (env var: ''). | Error: Missing option '--units'. |
| [] | Error: Missing option '--units' (env var: '[]'). | Error: Missing option '--units'. |
| ["WEATHER_UNITS", "UNITS"] (or a tuple) | ... (env var: '['WEATHER_UNITS', 'UNITS']'). | ... (env var: 'WEATHER_UNITS', 'UNITS'). |
| ["UNITS"] | ... (env var: '['UNITS']'). | ... (env var: 'UNITS'). |
| "UNITS" | ... (env var: 'UNITS'). | (unchanged) |

The help screen (--help) shows "--units TEXT  [env var: ]" for envvar="" and envvar=[]. An empty envvar ("" or []) must behave exactly like envvar=None, in help and in error hints, including with auto_envvar_prefix (prefix WEATHER: "[env var: WEATHER_UNITS]").
